Finance policy reminder: any supplier order over 150 pounds needs my sign-off before it is placed. Small recurring orders under that can go ahead as usual.

events.from: Deb Kaur (Fire Safety Officer, Marshbrook Council)
events.text: Following the spring survey, the licensed capacity of the Lakeside Room at Eastvale Community Hall is 80 persons. This is the figure to use for all bookings until further notice.

Hello Marcus, we would love to hold our autumn concert at the hall on Saturday 14 November. We expect around 80 people, so the Lakeside Room with its 80-person capacity would suit us well. Can you confirm?
Booked the Riverside Choir autumn concert for Saturday 14 November in the Lakeside Room, laid out for 80 seats, matching the room's licensed capacity of 80. Confirmed with Ruth Okafor.
Quote for concert refreshments: tea, coffee and biscuits at 1.75 pounds per cover, delivered to the hall kitchen on the day.

Ordered refreshments from Fairway Catering for the choir concert: 80 covers at 1.75 pounds each, 140 pounds in total, delivered to the hall kitchen on 14 November. Stays under the treasurer's 150 pound sign-off threshold.
Chair hire quote: folding chairs at 0.60 pounds per chair, delivered and collected from Eastvale Community Hall.
Ordered 80 folding chairs from Valley Hire at 0.60 pounds each for the choir concert on 14 November, matching the 80-seat plan for the Lakeside Room.
Marcus, the WI would like the Lakeside Room for our annual quiz night on Saturday 26 September. We are usually about 45 people.
Booked the Birdbrook WI quiz night for Saturday 26 September in the Lakeside Room, expecting 45 people, comfortably within the licensed capacity of 80.
Your standing price list: floor cleaner 9 pounds per 5-litre drum, bin liners 6 pounds per box.
Ordered the monthly cleaning restock from Easco: 4 drums of floor cleaner and 3 boxes of bin liners, 54 pounds in total, delivered to the hall store cupboard.
Notes from Saturday: the WI quiz night went well, 43 attended, room left tidy, deposit returned to Jean Mellor in full.
Hi Marcus, looking forward to the concert. Could you make sure the seating plan for the 80 seats is ready when we come to set up on the 14th?
